slides.title: Going Up Country
slides.body: Canned Heat’s Woodstock appearance put a wandering, blues-rooted festival anthem in the middle of the weekend.

slides.title: What you are watching
slides.body: ‘Going Up the Country’ had become one of Canned Heat's best-known songs by the time the band reached Bethel. Its country-bound refrain fit a festival where movement, escape, and temporary community were always in the air.
